reason: cicflowmeter 0.5.0 upstream runtime bug crashes the frozen capture script's file-mode extractor call before any flow is produced; discovered before any final-test scoring.

bug.cause: main() calls create_sniffer positionally so args.fields lands in input_directory and args.verbose (False) lands in fields; False.split(',') then raises.

fix.mechanism: corrected copy of upstream main() that calls create_sniffer with keyword arguments and reuses the installed 0.5.0 extraction code unchanged; exposed on PATH as cicflowmeter so the frozen capture script runs unedited.

unchanged_and_reaffirmed.csv_output_contract: 82-column cicflowmeter CSV -> 76 numeric features after dropping the six identity columns

verification.host_end_to_end_extractor_test: not run on host; cicflowmeter 0.5.0 requires Python >= 3.12 and the host analysis venv is 3.11; no cicflowmeter version installed or altered on the host. Real-PCAP smoke test runs in Kali before final captures (see EXTRACTOR_COMPAT.md).

restart_precondition: this amendment is committed and pushed before any new eval-v1-* capture; the Kali extractor smoke test passes.
